.modal {

    width: 100% !important;

display: none;

/* Hidden by default */

position: fixed;

/* Stay in place */

z-index: 1;

/* Sit on top */

padding-top: 200px;

/* Location of the box */

left: 0;

top: 0;

background-color: rgb(0, 0, 0);

/* Fallback color */

background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);

/* Black w/ opacity */

}

 

.modal-content{

position: relative;

background-color: #fefefe;

    width: 57%;

margin: auto;

padding: 0;

border: 1px solid #888;

box-shadow: 0 4px 8px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0 6px 20px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.19);

-webkit-animation-name: animatetop;

-webkit-animation-duration: 0.4s;

animation-name: animatetop;

animation-duration: 0.4s

}

 .secondModal-content{

position: relative;

background-color: #fefefe;

    width: 57%;

margin: auto;

padding-left: 0px;

border: 1px solid #888;

box-shadow: 0 4px 8px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0 6px 20px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.19);

-webkit-animation-name: animatetop;

-webkit-animation-duration: 0.4s;

animation-name: animatetop;

animation-duration: 0.4s

}

 

@media (max-width : 767px){

.modal-content {

width: 100%;

    }

 

    .secondModal-content{

width: 100%;

    }

}

from {

opacity: 0

guidetextdraw_990081357._value:
Your petition statement is comprised of your responses to ITEMS 1 and 2 below, and your answers to the questions under ITEM 3.

ONE EXCEPTION PER FORM
guidetextdraw_990081357.name: textdraw_9900813571669187893534

guidetextdraw_2063767164._value:
ITEM 1: State the specific G.E. graduation requirement for which you are seeking an exception.

 Examples: lacking 2 units in G.E. Area D4: lacking 3 units of upper-division G.E. etc.
guidetextdraw_2063767164.name: textdraw_20637671641670486048480

guidetextdraw_1304700011._value:
ITEM 2: State the alternative course you are requesting to be used for fulfilling this requirement and the reason(s) that this would be an appropriate substitution for the deficiency you have listed in Item 1. above.

(You cannot request to waive a graduation requirement.)
guidetextdraw_1304700011.name: textdraw_13047000111670486212704

guidetextdraw_776729254._value:
ITEM 3:The rest of your petition statement consists of answers to the four questions, (a) through (d), below

(a) When, and how, did you become aware that you had not yet met the requirement for which you are submitting this petition? (through an advisor, by reviewing your Titan Degree Audit on your own, etc)
guidetextdraw_776729254.name: textdraw_7767292541670486392313

guidetextdraw_1946763324._value: (b) Describe the other options for meeting this requirement which you have considered.
guidetextdraw_1946763324.name: textdraw_19467633241670486507408

guidetextdraw_579428328._value:
(c) Have you ever sought advisement through either the Academic Advisement Center, or through your major department?

 If so, when? If not, why not?
guidetextdraw_579428328.name: textdraw_5794283281670486692501

guidetextdraw_53580688._value:
(d) What extenuating circumstances prevent you from taking a course at this time to meet the G.E. requirement for which you are requesting a variation? (Documentation for circumstances must be provided with your petition.)

If you have questions related to documentation of circumstances, please ask for assistance from a Records Office representative.

EXPLANATION OF EXTENUATING CIRCUMSTANCES:
